This isn't for most of you, and I'd rather say it in the first line than waste your time on a call.

If you want signals, it does nothing. If you've never traded real money, there's nothing to diagnose yet — your wiring only shows up under real risk. And if you don't want anyone looking at what you actually did, the whole thing collapses.

What's left: traders who know the theory, have lost real money, and keep breaking the same rule at the same moment. Five per month.

Comment "PROFILE" and I'll open the qualification.
